messages:
liz: Heads-up — we're starting a staged rollout for runtime v2.7.3 on 2024-11-06 00:00 UTC. Target is phased across regions (canary -> ramp). We'll pin Dedicated tenants to rdx-v2.7.2 for the quiet window to avoid model regressions. Need a concise statuspage blurb + an email template for tenant admins. who can draft?
amar: i'm on it. will draft both. quick Q: any tenants we should explicitly exclude from the pining plan?
jamal: support: priority = EU dedicated customers with strict change windows. we have 4 tenants running custom kernels — flag them, but do not exclude unless kernel patch required.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/v2.7.3 -> canary(us-east-1) at 2024-11-06T00:00:00Z. est duration: 45m per phase. rollout policy: 20% -> 50% -> 100% unless errors detected.
liz: decision: pin Dedicated tenants during the maintenance window. use: `redwoodctl pin-version --tenant <tenant-id> --model rdx-v2.7.2 --until 2024-11-06T04:00:00Z` for each tenant we want to pin. we'll unpin after validation.
sre-ops: oncall note: if p50 latency increases >15% sustained for 5m in canary, hold the rollout. rollback command: `redwoodctl rollback runtime v2.7.2` and then re-pin affected tenants. paging policy: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-runtime.
amar: statuspage draft (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance: We will perform a phased deployment of the Redwood inference runtime starting 2024-11-06 00:00 UTC. Some Dedicated customers will be temporarily pinned to the previous model version to preserve stability during the update. Expected window: up to 4 hours. Services will remain available; you may see brief increases in latency. We will post progress updates here and notify affected tenants directly.
```
amar: email subject: "[Redwood] Planned maintenance: runtime update (2024-11-06)"
amar: email body (short):
```
Hi <Tenant Admin>,

We will be performing a planned runtime update on 2024-11-06 starting at 00:00 UTC. To minimize risk, we will temporarily pin Dedicated tenants to the previous model version for the duration of the maintenance window. Expected impact: services remain online; brief latency blips possible.

What we will do:
- Apply runtime v2.7.3 in phased canaries and ramps.
- Pin dedicated tenants to rdx-v2.7.2 for the window.
- Monitor latency and error rates; rollback if regressions occur.

If you have questions or need us to opt your account out of the pin, reply to this email or contact support.

Regards,
Redwood Support
```
jamal: we'll send to tenant admins 48h and 2h before start. support-lead: I'll queue the Intercom campaign for tenant admins and attach the short FAQ.
support-lead: include the oncall contact in the email footer: oncall@redwood.ai and support-esc@redwood.ai.
jamal: also add a statuspage update cadence: post at 30m before start, at each phase transition, and on completion/rollback.
liz: final note — i will trigger the statuspage post 30m before and push the canary. I'm logging the pin commands in the deploy runbook. If we hit the hold criteria, we'll perform rollback + pin re-apply to affected tenants and update the status page with the rollback note.
sre-ops: ack. I'll prepare a short runbook snippet and attach monitoring queries to the canary dashboard (p50, p95, errors/sec).
liz: thanks team. tagging this thread for release notes and to attach the final email copy once queued. :thumbsup:
